name: updatePost
label: Update a Post
description: Edits the content and/or title of a draft or scheduled post. Published posts cannot be edited.

parameters.name: postId
parameters.label: Post ID
parameters.help: ID of the draft or scheduled post to edit.

parameters.name: content
parameters.label: Content
parameters.help: New post text/caption. Leave empty to keep the current content.

parameters.name: title
parameters.label: Title
parameters.help: New title (used by YouTube and Pinterest). Leave empty to keep the current title.
